# ledger API

## ledger.balances

### `balance(entries)`

The sum of the entries' amounts, in cents.

### `balance_by_account(entries)`

Each account's balance, in cents.

### `balance_on(entries, day)`

The balance at the end of a day, in cents: the entries up to and including that day.

## ledger.entries

### `entry(account, cents, day, memo='')`

A ledger entry: an amount in cents on an account, on a day.

### `parse_day(text)`

A day written YYYY-MM-DD.
